signal: Data Dimensions operates in the business process automation market, which is projected to nearly triple to $19.6B by 2026 as agentic AI and intelligent automation drive enterprise adoption.

email.body1:
Scott, with the business process automation market projected to hit $19.6B in 2026 on the back of agentic AI, Data Dimensions sits right in the demand curve.

That surge usually means more in-market accounts than a BD team can touch before they cool. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Data Dimensions off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Scott, quick follow-up for Data Dimensions.

A market growing this fast fills the funnel, but most BD teams don't actually know how many meetings they need to book to capture their share. The gap shows up late, and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings your BD team needs this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Scott, last bit of proof for Data Dimensions.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Data Dimensions' reply rate likely compares to other automation vendors. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
email.body4:
Scott, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling BD coverage without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Chasing a fast-growing market is its own kind of busy, and timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to an automation BD motion? I'll tailor it to Data Dimensions either way.
